title: Git & GitHub Bootcamp
description: A from-zero workshop on version control, branching, and pull requests, ending with everyone shipping their first PR to a shared repo.

title: Build Night: Ship a Landing Page
description: Bring a laptop, leave with a deployed landing page. Mentors on hand for HTML/CSS/JS questions.

title: DevSoc Hackathon: Orbit
description: 24-hour hackathon. Teams of up to 4. Prizes for best build, best design, and best first-time hacker project.

title: Resume + Portfolio Review
description: 1:1 slots with alumni working in tech to review resumes and GitHub portfolios ahead of placement season.

archive.summary: 35 members attended 1:1 slots with 6 alumni reviewers. Most-requested follow-up: a mock interview night.

title: Intro to React Workshop
description: Hands-on session building a small React app from scratch, covering components, state, and props.

archive.summary: 48 attendees, 9 finished projects presented in the last 20 minutes.
